sketches.design_lens: A.G. Cook (imagined taste brief, not artist-authentic)
sketches.intent: Shamelessly melodic glossy plastic lead: pointed index/Tone front settles into a simple strong held center. Mono legato all-pitch glide, small phrase-only common-direction scoop, tiny undelayed global vibrato. Be the hook, not a distortion demonstration. No high network stress, opposed bend, long room, evolving ratio routes or rhythmic gating. Not another gritty/resonant experimental lead or an authentic artist recipe.

sketches.design_lens: A.G. Cook (imagined taste brief, not artist-authentic)
sketches.intent: Thin, exposed, buzzy electronic ensemble played with sincerity. Triangle-rich near-unison operator tap gives a cheap beating string edge, direct moderate entrance and sustained chords, shallow global vibrato. Keep artificiality audible instead of polishing it into an ambient wash. No slow index/ratio/cutoff evolution, giant Space, chord helper, network distortion or huge attack/release. Near-unison tap is not a new chorus engine or independently detuned ensemble.

sketches.study_axis: hard crystalline key with soft interior
sketches.design_lens: A.G. Cook (imagined taste brief, not artist-authentic)
sketches.intent: Tiny abrasive harmonic bite followed by a round restrained key body. Strong very brief shaped1:1FM index strike, short bright Tone contour and velocity opening; hard playing exposes the teeth, soft playing feels delicate. Shared Tone uses last-note velocity, not independent per-operator/per-voice velocity layers. No inharmonic bell ratio, filter-FM tine body, slow pluck-vowel sweep, pitch entrance, stress distortion or long room. Not an acoustic piano, electric-piano model, sample layer or authentic artist recipe.
